Class PlayerFigure

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.vision.PlayerFigure
public final class PlayerFigure extends Object
The player model as the game draws it, worked out from a PlayerPose: six boxes (head, body, two arms, two legs) with the sizes, pivots and animation of the game's own model, each including its outer skin layer. The numbers are the game's (1.21.11: HumanoidModel, PlayerModel, LivingEntityRenderer); the only things left out are what the opponent holds and poses that never occur in a sword fight (swimming, gliding, riding, sleeping).

Not thread-safe.
